segments.title: Opening & Trailer Block Kickoff
segments.notes: Case opens Town Hall Tuesday with movie trailer requests; announces new Town Hall segment price-locked behind 10 subs.

segments.title: Golden Kappa Train Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train manifests as 'King Golden Kappa Toran,' an immortal cursed monarch whose rectum transmutes all inserted matter into gold; extended lore improvisation consumes trailer block.

segments.title: Kendall Near-Miss Debrief
segments.notes: Kendelle arrives on-set after two near-fatal LA traffic incidents; Case establishes 'Kendall Relief Fund' (dinner) from stream donations.

segments.title: Trailer Block: Hit Man & Deadfall (1993)
segments.notes: Hit Man (Glen Powell) and Nicolas Cage/Charlie Sheen cult flop Deadfall trailers screened; Case champions Deadfall's $18K box office as 'worth every dollar.'

segments.title: Trailer Block: Atlas (J.Lo Sci-Fi)
segments.notes: Jennifer Lopez AI-action trailer Atlas discussed; Case praises Lopez 'acting in a box' commitment, debates robot ass aesthetics with chat.

segments.title: Don Wriggles Trump Hush-Money Recap
segments.notes: Insult comedian Don Wriggles delivers hush-money trial updates (Pecker testimony, Stormy Daniels fact-checks) while attacking Case's hygiene.

segments.title: Town Hall: Donald Trump Fields Questions
segments.notes: Lawn Soap hosts town hall with Donald Trump; audience asks about mushroom taxonomy, self-resurrection, LA driver veteran status, hand-game mechanics, Melania's $6B purchase price, time-travel bear assassinations, and prison dick-holding logistics.

segments.title: ASMR Rocket Raccoon Therapy Session
segments.notes: ASMR Rocket Raccoon sees raccoon therapist; mouth-sound ASMR duel (toothbrush, banana, bubble wrap, foil); therapist admits impostor syndrome, enables trash relapse.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid to Kassim
segments.notes: Case ends stream at two-hour 'legal limit,' raids Kassim, plugs Patreon dream stream tomorrow.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors Town Hall Tuesday; survives Golden Kappa Train derailment, manages Kendall crisis, oversees chaotic Trump town hall.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Manifests as King Golden Kappa Toran, an immortal cursed king whose ass transmutes all offerings to gold, dominating 25 minutes of airtime.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Survives dual near-miss car accidents en route to studio; receives 'Kendall Relief Fund' dinner from stream donations.

characters.name: Don Wriggles
characters.notes: insult comedian. Delivers Trump hush-money trial recap while relentlessly mocking Case's chair hygiene and personal scent.

characters.name: Lawn Soap
characters.notes: town hall host. Debuts as town hall moderator; struggles with technical 'fixy-dos' while fielding Trump and audience chaos.

characters.name: ASMR Rocket Raccoon
characters.notes: therapy patient. Attends raccoon therapy; demonstrates mouth-sound ASMR repertoire (toothbrush, banana, bubble wrap, foil) and admits trash addiction.

characters.name: Therapy Doctor
characters.notes: Raccoon therapist who reveals impostor syndrome, enables patient's trash relapse, and denies cure for brain diseases.

lore_notes.fact: Golden Kappa Train variant 'King Golden Kappa Toran' claims 6,000-year immortality and a curse where anything inserted into his rectum — including bits, subs, crowns, stone tablets, and family members — transmutes to gold.
Survived two near-fatal LA traffic incidents in one commute: first a lane-swerve into adjacent traffic, second a van turning left then crossing straight into her lane.
Debuts as dedicated town hall host, claiming 'I never leave the town hall if I can help it' and performing live technical 'fixy-dos' mid-broadcast.
Identifies as 'mouth ASMR guy' not 'prop ASMR guy'; demonstrates raccoon-specific sounds (toothbrushing, banana eating, bubble wrap, aluminum foil) and admits uncontrolled trash addiction.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell's Town Hall Tuesday opens with a movie trailer block that gets hijacked by a Golden Kappa Train Hype Train variant claiming an ancient rectal transmutation curse. After Kendelle survives twin near-miss car crashes, Don Wriggles delivers a hush-money trial recap before Lawn Soap moderates a surreal town hall where Donald Trump fields questions on mushroom taxonomy, self-resurrection, LA drivers as war veterans, Melania's $6B cash purchase, time-travel bear assassinations, and prison dick-holding economics. The broadcast closes with ASMR Rocket Raccoon attending raccoon therapy, where a mouth-sound duel ends in the therapist enabling a trash relapse.
